description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Gabranth], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Dark abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Dark Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Dark Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Dark Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)] and [Dark Ability Quick Cast (Tactical)] to user if an enemy has at least 40% imperil dark, causes [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] to all enemies if not

description.name: Dark Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Dark attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Dark Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 30% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Instant ATB 1

description.name: Dark Ability Quick Cast (Tactical)
